items.headline: Trump says the Iran war is 'effectively over' militarily
items.summary: After meeting Qatar's prime minister in Washington, Trump said the US was now just keeping the 'status quo' at the request of Iran's neighbours. Iranian officials dismissed his remarks as 'fake news'.

items.headline: Republican congressman moves to impeach Defence Secretary Hegseth
items.summary: Thomas Massie filed a resolution to impeach Pete Hegseth over the war on Iran. President Trump and Marco Rubio have defended Hegseth.

items.headline: France brings forward minimum wage rise to calm protests
items.summary: The government is speeding up a rise in the minimum wage after weeks of protests over living costs, including more than 140,000 marchers on Saturday.

items.headline: FTSE 100 bounces back 1% as miners rally
items.summary: London's top index rose 1.02% on Monday to 10,782.87, helped by mining shares, while oil fell on hopes of a deal over Iran. It had dropped about 1% on Friday.

items.headline: UK house prices fall at fastest yearly rate in three years
items.summary: October's figures showed the sharpest annual fall in house prices since 2023, as higher borrowing costs weigh on buyers.

items.headline: Microsoft offers about 60,000 staff voluntary exits
items.summary: The company has offered buyouts to around 60,000 employees. Microsoft says AI isn't the reason, though its boss has talked about millions of AI agents working alongside staff.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic released new top models for complex technical work. It says a team of 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents fully formalised the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in 30 hours during testing.

items.headline: Nvidia shares slump as its boss faces an investigation
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell after news of an investigation into chief executive Jensen Huang. President Trump defended Huang.

items.headline: OpenAI and ADNOC bring AI agents to oil and gas
items.summary: OpenAI is working with Abu Dhabi's national oil company on linked AI agents, starting with planning for oil and gas fields.
